title: Straw boss and the notice rescinded by Mills
summary: Thomas explains how he got his notice and Mills ordered it rescinded.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: And Bennie brought up something else, that I was the straw boss!
Well, let me tell you this story about that. You know, they gave me my notice between the Savoy Ballroom

and... Because see, Cab, when we decided to stay with the band, I guess he got the idea to change to different musicians. So I guess I was next on the list. So I didn't think too much about it. I kind of hated to leave the band, because it was beginning to do good. So next time Cab and I went downtown to see Mills, I told Mills, I said, "I got my notice." He said, "What?! You got your notice? He must be crazy." You see, Mills liked me because I used to always come downtown with Cab, and the songs he'd pick out, if they didn't have an arrangement for them, I'd make the arrangement, and after I'd made the arrangement for "Minnie The Moocher" I guess Mills took a liking to me.

So he called the Cotton Club and said, "You're going to take Walter Thomas back out and put him in Mills' Blue Rhythm Band" -- he had that band, too, you know. So then they rescinded the notice, so I stayed.
